title: Commercial and Residential Property Secretary
company: Clear Legal & Financial Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking to recruit an experienced Legal Secretary to join our Property Team which deals with both Commercial and Residential Property transactions. Previous Commercial and Residential Property experience is essential; however, we welcome applications from any candidates who demonstrate the skills, professionalism and aptitude required to succeed in the role.

Working closely with the fee-earners, you will provide high-quality administrative and secretarial support to assist with the smooth and efficient progression of Property transactions.

You will play an important role in ensuring files are well organised, deadlines are met, and clients receive a professional and friendly service throughout.

Key Responsibilities
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the Property Team
- Preparing, formatting and processing correspondence and legal documentation
- Opening, maintaining and closing files
- Liaising with clients, estate agents and other third parties
- Handling telephone and email enquiries in a professional manner
- Assisting fee earners with the progression of Commercial and Residential sales, purchases, remortgages and other Property transactions
- Requesting and monitoring searches, property information and other documentation
- Assisting with exchange and completion processes and ensuring relevant parties are kept updated
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring the case management system is kept up to date
- Monitoring key dates, deadlines and outstanding information
- Assisting with post-completion administration where required
- Providing a high level of client service and ensuring clients receive timely updates
- Supporting the Property Team with general administrative duties as required

Should you have any questions or wish to apply please do not hesitate to contact Clear Legal and Financial.

Please Note: Due to the number of applications we receive we may be unable to respond to every application directly. If you have not heard from us within 3 working days please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant

Offering £26,000 - £28,000 Basic Salary plus Great Benefits

Harrogate

Our client is an established manufacturing business based in Harrogate. Now recruiting a Marketing Assistant to join their friendly and established marketing team. The successful candidate will provide hands-on support across digital marketing, graphic design and artwork coordination, website and CMS updates, email marketing, social media, events, webinars, product launches, reporting and marketing administration.

Marketing Assistant - Key Responsibilities
- Work closely with the Graphic Designer to support artwork requests, design amendments and the coordination of marketing materials.
- Provide graphic design and artwork support, helping manage and complete artwork requests and amendments. Complete artwork tasks such as flyers, business cards, certificates, CPD materials, minor product collateral amends, sales support documents and sector-specific templates. Assisting the Graphic Designer Lead on larger creative projects, such as product launches, packaging and new marketing materials.
- Support the digital marketing team to maintain creative and digital outputs, supporting social media content creation, scheduling, monitoring, reporting and recommendations for improved content performance.
- Support product launches and go-to-market activity, including digital marketing, sales team communications, lead generation, print, press, awareness activity and third-party supplier coordination.
- Take ownership of marketing actions for new starters and leavers within sales teams, including business cards, promotional items, photography, website updates, territory artwork, CRM and website lead allocation, communications groups and social media welcome content.
- Support PPC and paid digital activity by working with external suppliers and preparing campaign assets for awareness, performance and PMax activity.
- Manage the marketing inbox daily, responding to queries, completing actions, escalating where required and tracking next steps.
- Collate marketing performance data for the department, including website, social media, email and YouTube reporting.

Marketing Assistant - Candidate
- Detail orientated with strong Adobe InDesign skills.
- Graphic design experience is essential.
- Knowledge, experience or a genuine interest in digital marketing would be advantageous.
- Highly organised with strong time-management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive attitude towards learning and developing new skills.
- Be team orientated, with the ability to work independently.

The Marketing Assistant position is offering £26,000 - £28,000 basic salary plus great benefits for the successful candidate! This is a full-time, permanent, site-based position in Harrogate.

All successful candidates will be contacted within 5 days of application for the position of Marketing Assistant. This vacancy is being advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd. The services advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Technical & Quality Support Administrator
description:
Technical & Quality Support Administrator

Harrogate £28,000 - £30,000 Monday to Friday (flexible on hours)

Benefits: 25 days holiday + bank holidays, Christmas shutdown, paid sick leave, company pension, free on-site parking, training and career development opportunities

Unity Resourcing is recruiting a Technical & Quality Support Administrator for a successful and growing food manufacturing business based in Harrogate.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Food Science graduate looking to start their career, or an individual with experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Technical Administration or Food Safety who is looking to further develop their skills within a supportive and fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Technical & Quality Support Administrator Duties:
- Completing customer specifications and technical documentation
- Investigating customer complaints and supporting corrective actions
- Carrying out GMP inspections and internal audits
- Supporting HACCP and food safety systems
- Maintaining quality records, procedures and documentation
- Assisting with external audits and certification requirements
- Managing supplier approvals and raw material specifications
- Supporting environmental monitoring, calibration and shelf-life testing
- Delivering training and assisting with continuous improvement activities

About You
- Degree in Food Science or a related discipline, or previous food manufacturing quality experience
- Understanding of GMP and food safety principles
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Excellent communication skills
- Confident using IT systems and technical documentation
- HACCP and audit experience would be advantageous but is not essential

To apply or discuss the opportunity further, please contact Beth Davies at Unity Resourcing or submit your CV today.
